verdict.rationale: Skills can bundle executable scripts (anthropic-skills-docs-52), and the spec's example PDF skill "merges multiple PDFs" (anthropic-skills-docs-32), so a skill can carry multi-item logic. Separately, the surrounding Claude Code tooling offers piped input, subagents and agent teams that could fan work out across items (anthropic-skills-docs-83, anthropic-skills-docs-79, anthropic-skills-docs-56). None of this is a documented bulk-operation capability of Skills themselves; it is only implied by these building blocks. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation mechanism, worked examples of applying a skill across many items, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk use.
